_comment: Copy this to <name-in-lowercase>.json and fill in the three fields.
name   the product as the operator sees it. Everything else is derived:
the exe (<lowercase>_console.exe), the window titles, the captures
folder (Documents\<name> captures) and the capture file prefix.
blurb  one short phrase for the exe's Properties -> Details description.
panels optional GUI windows beyond the terminal. [] is terminal-only.
Known ids live in PANELS in b360_console_app.py; today that is
"waveform". A panel that SETS things on the device rather than
displaying a query must declare writes:true there and echo what it
appearance  optional. "lightdark" (the default) is the Light/Dark select;
"wheel" is a colour wheel for the window colour. The wheel styles
the terminal only, so do not combine it with the waveform panel.
name: B560
